item_short_desc: Rothco’s Molon Labe Skull T-Shirt brings a bold and historic message to your wardrobe, featuring a powerful graphic of a skull with 2 crossed rifles and the iconic “Molon Labe” phrase, which translates to "Come and Take It." This statement originates from King Leonidas of Sparta, symbolizing defiance and strength. Printed on a durable yet soft cotton / polyester fabric blend, the graphic shirt offers both comfort and longevity, making it perfect for everyday wear or as a standout piece for special occasions.
description: Rothco’s Molon Labe Skull T-Shirt brings a bold and historic message to your wardrobe, featuring a powerful graphic of a skull with 2 crossed rifles and the iconic “Molon Labe” phrase, which translates to "Come and Take It." This statement originates from King Leonidas of Sparta, symbolizing defiance and strength. Printed on a durable yet soft cotton / polyester fabric blend, the graphic shirt offers both comfort and longevity, making it perfect for everyday wear or as a standout piece for special occasions. The Molon Labe text is displayed across a banner beneath the skull graphic, adding depth and detail to the design. With a tag-less label for added comfort, you’ll enjoy a smooth, irritation-free fit. Whether for personal use or as a gift, Rothco’s Molon Labe Skull T-Shirt is perfect for those who value both history and style.
